scope: Diagnostic capture of one ODA-produced AC1024 custom IMAGEDEF with a role-4 owner. This is not DXF output qualification, native-client qualification, or a general DWG ownership rule.

source.provenance: Scratch DXF authored from scratch with ezdxf 1.4.5 using tools/audit_ac1024_rastervariables_source.py; converted to ACAD2010 DWG by ODA File Converter 27.1.0. No fixture was added.
source.independent_observation: LibreDWG 0.14 trace reports IMAGEDEF handle 0x31, body size 68 bytes, handle-stream bit boundary 493, owner token role 4 to 0x30, and reactor role-4 tokens to 0x30 and 0x33. IMAGEDEF_REACTOR 0x33 has class version 2 and role-4 owner to IMAGE 0x32. IMAGE 0x32 references definition 0x31 and reactor 0x33 and carries an 8-byte proxy preview. This graph observation does not prove output closure or proxy preservation.

authority_conflict: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.1 describes the common object parent as a soft pointer, while section 20.4.81 describes the IMAGEDEF parent as a hard owner. The handle-type table specifies role 4 as soft pointer and role 3 as hard ownership. The producer witness agrees with the common wording and conflicts with the IMAGEDEF-specific wording. The semantics are not established as equivalent.
implementation: The in-tree bit observer, separate from the typed parser returns UnqualifiedOwnerRole only for custom-class AC1024 IMAGEDEF after all supported EED, body, string span, owner, reactors, extension dictionary and tail boundaries are observed; the adapter additionally correlates typed fields, EED count and the separately reparsed source with immutable snapshots. Its text decoding is not independently certified. Before EED parsing the AC1024 detached owner is inspected so unsupported EED with role 4 remains malformed/refused. Fixed-type role 4, zero role-4 owners, unrelated roles, malformed handles, and truncation remain rejected. The diagnostic status is explicitly rejected at the existing output gate for every output policy; it cannot become generic Unsupported or Proven.
compatibility_limit: Unconditional role-4 refusal described here applies to this bounded AC1024 diagnostic profile. Existing generic Unsupported behavior for other revisions is unchanged and requires separate review. No change is made to public ABI or default output admission.
physical_results: The exact witness imports with immutable snapshots of IMAGEDEF 0x31 and reactor 0x33 and no raster source capture failure. Mutating the IMAGEDEF typed file name or appending EED causes source correlation failure; a clean same-reader re-import captures the diagnostic again. For ASCII and Binary, all three completeness policies and both owner-resolution modes refuse with the specific unqualified-owner diagnostic. Two repeated attempts in each combination preserve an existing destination. Separate scratch checks also confirmed strict-mode attempts do not create an absent destination. These are refusal/re-import checks, not a successful corrected export.
prior_evidence: The earlier p4-ac1024-rastervariables-direct-nod-2026-11-04.json recorded BAD_READ_HEADER before later AC1024 header diagnostic admission; that historical observation is superseded for this exact witness. The header still reports 739 unclaimed bytes from offsets 843 through 1581. Physical source-to-output RASTERVARIABLES handle remapping, IMAGE graph/proxy closure and whole-file strict completeness remain unqualified.

validation.sha_binding: Verify the source SHA-256 is fc1371b35a566d916b4fd143e66333c6695dbd341aa31b2025bc5dcd45fe30ce both immediately before and immediately after the physical selector; this is mandatory because the selector is witness-specific. tools/audit_ac1024_rastervariables_source.py verify also provides mandatory pre/post SHA binding for the separate source-frame probe.

remaining: Resolve the internal specification/producer ownership conflict with authoritative guidance and additional independent evidence; separately qualify source graph, proxy preview retention, header suffix, and native readback before considering output admission.
adjacent_audit: Outside this AC1024 path, examined unknown-EED examples return generic Unsupported but were rejected by native reparse before output. That observation does not establish safety for other Unsupported reasons; audit them separately. No exploitable bypass is established by this observation.
